resource.title: V2 OFFICIAL UPDATE
resource.description: This mod includes a total of 14 songs, an expanded story from the original first update and the V2 demo, complete with revamps made to dated and old assets. Two difficulty levels are available: "CANON" for those who want to play the mod as intended and seek a challenge, and "CASUAL" for those who prefer a more relaxed experience.
